for kw in df_agg['KW'].unique():
    
    df_kw = df_agg[df_agg['KW'] == kw]

    # Pivot: Month vs Variant
    pivot_kw = df_kw.pivot_table(
        index='Month&year',
        columns='RRS_Classification',
        values='DeliveryQty',
        aggfunc='sum',
        fill_value=0
    )

    # Need at least 2 variants to correlate
    if pivot_kw.shape[1] < 2:
        continue

    corr = pivot_kw.corr()

    plt.figure(figsize=(6, 5))
    sns.heatmap(
        corr,
        cmap='coolwarm',
        center=0,
        annot=True,
        fmt=".2f"
    )
    plt.title(f'Variant Demand Correlation within {kw} kW')
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

def compute_features(x):
    demand = x['DeliveryQty'].values
    
    return pd.Series({
        'AvgDemand': demand.mean(),
        'StdDemand': demand.std(),
        'CV2': (demand.std() / demand.mean())**2 if demand.mean() > 0 else 0,
        'Intermittency': np.mean(demand == 0),
        'ZeroPct': np.mean(demand == 0)
    })

features = (
    grp
    .groupby(['KW', 'RRS_Classification'])
    .apply(compute_features)
    .reset_index()
)

from scipy.stats import chi2
import numpy as np

# PCA coordinates
coords = pca_df[['PC1', 'PC2']].values

# Mean & covariance
mean = coords.mean(axis=0)
cov = np.cov(coords, rowvar=False)
inv_cov = np.linalg.inv(cov)

# Mahalanobis distance
def mahalanobis(x, mean, inv_cov):
    diff = x - mean
    return np.sqrt(diff @ inv_cov @ diff.T)

pca_df['MD'] = [mahalanobis(x, mean, inv_cov) for x in coords]

# Threshold (95% confidence ellipse)
threshold = np.sqrt(chi2.ppf(0.95, df=2))

outliers = pca_df[pca_df['MD'] > threshold]
outliers
